newsitem.title: UK: PREMIER AUTO TRUST SETS $920 MLN ASSET-BACKED BOND.
newsitem.headline: PREMIER AUTO TRUST SETS $920 MLN ASSET-BACKED BOND.

text.p: Premier Auto Trust 1997-2 has launched a five-tranche asset-backed bond for a total of $920 million, lead manager Bear Stearns said.
Class A2 notes total $250 million, mature in November 1999, have an average life of 0.92 years and will be priced to yield 32 basis points over the July 1998 U.S. Treasury.
Class A3 notes total $235 million, mature in September 2000, have an average life of 1.61 years and will be priced at 26 b.p. over the March 1999 Treasury.
Class A4 notes total $200 million, mature in June 2001, have an average life of 2.33 years and will be priced at 27 b.p. over the December 1999 Treasury.
Class A5 notes total $190 million, mature in March 2002, have an average life of 3.14 years and will be priced at 28 b.p. over the three-year Treasury.
Class B notes total $45 million, mature in December 2003, have an average life of 3.53 years and will be priced at 42 b.p. over the February 2001 Treasury. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
